4. Retrieve the CO2 structure using its mp_id.
5. Identify the adsorption sites on the selected slab.
6. Choose the adsorption site based on the site type and site index.
7. Add the CO2 adsorbate to the slab at the chosen site with the specified height.
8. Save the final combined structure as a CIF file.
